parameters.query: SELECT * FROM projects WHERE id = $1::uuid LIMIT 1

SELECT id, option_number, title, description, intervention_logic, rooms_layout, technical_notes FROM design_options WHERE project_id = $1::uuid AND exec_status = 'confirmed' ORDER BY CASE WHEN is_selected = true THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id, category, name, unit_price, unit, quantity_estimated, total_estimated, room_area, notes FROM material_items WHERE project_id = $1::uuid AND status = 'approved' ORDER BY category
SELECT * FROM regulatory_tasks WHERE project_id = $1::uuid AND exec_status = 'confirmed' ORDER BY priority
SELECT * FROM price_references ORDER BY partida
SELECT mc.* FROM memory_cases mc JOIN projects p ON p.id = $1::uuid WHERE mc.project_type = p.project_type AND mc.cost_final IS NOT NULL ORDER BY mc.created_at DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT * FROM agent_prompts WHERE agent_name = 'agent_costs' AND is_active = true ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
INSERT INTO agent_executions (project_id, agent_name, status) VALUES ($1::uuid, 'agent_costs', 'running') RETURNING id

INSERT INTO cost_estimates (project_id, version, total_estimated, budget_target, deviation_pct, deviation_status, breakdown, adjustments_suggested, scenarios, assumptions, risk_notes, status) VALUES ($1::uuid, COALESCE((SELECT MAX(version) FROM cost_estimates WHERE project_id = $1::uuid), 0) + 1, $2::numeric, $3::numeric, $4::numeric, $5, $6::jsonb, $7::jsonb, $8::jsonb, $9::jsonb, $10, 'draft') RETURNING id
UPDATE cost_estimates SET status = 'reviewed' WHERE id = $1::uuid
UPDATE agent_executions SET status = 'completed', finished_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1::uuid

parameters.query: SELECT id, pathology_type, severity, urgency, structural, affects_safety, affects_habitability, location_in_property, description, recommended_action, estimated_intervention_cost_min, estimated_intervention_cost_max, requires_specialist, specialist_type FROM pathology_findings WHERE project_id = $1::uuid AND status NOT IN ('repaired','dismissed') ORDER BY CASE severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 0 WHEN 'high' THEN 1 WHEN 'medium' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END;
